hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A managed token launch platform hook that collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode) via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Pool initialization is gated to a designated launch manager, only one liquidity position is permitted per pool, and liquidity removal is permanently disabled.
